propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed via the administrative disposition path because the plan-review close gate does not receive the close_class parameter and cannot evaluate the evidence.

The plan-review close gate demands a plan-review attestation unconditionally for task/story/epic tickets, but review-plan cannot pass for genuinely superseded work, creating an unsatisfiable loop that forces use of --force.

The completion verification gate honors link-backed administrative dispositions as evidence and skips verification, but the plan-review close gate was never wired to receive this evidence, leaving the two gates asymmetric.
Forced closes of superseded tickets strip completion signatures from entire ancestor chains, degrading audit trails for epics containing legitimately superseded children.

The obligation to handle link-backed administrative dispositions was created when dispositions were extended to task/story/epic types, but only the completion gate was updated and the plan-review gate was left unchanged.
